content:
alex: Morning — quick async: I pushed a small routing tweak that prefers regional pool for /v1/embed. Canary 10% now. PR #4829. Rolling for 60m. Ping me if you see new 5xxs.

deploy-bot: deploy started by alex at 09:07 UTC — canary=10% · build 2026.3.15-14

maria: saw one 503 at 09:12 in eu-west-1, trace id abc123. backend recovered. I ran quick smoke (curl) and got 200.

cheng: FYI I bumped internal token-exchange rate-limits to avoid token-swap storms — added 10% jitter and backoff. snippet:
```
rate_limit:
  unit: minute
  limit: 1200
  jitter: 0.10
  backoff_ms: 200
```

olivia: blocker: auth team plans JWK rotation at 11:30 UTC — they asked us to hold any major rollouts until after 12:00. If rotation goes long, we may need to pause ramp.

alex: plan: keep canary at 10% until 12:15, then if rate/error budget ok ramp to 50%. If auth rotation overlaps we'll pause. Also @cheng can you review PR #4831 (auth backoff changes)?

cheng: on it, ETA ~30m.

maria: I'll run 99p latency checks + token exchange histograms after the 50% ramp. Will post results here.

olivia: quick prod-check command for folks: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health | jq .` — look for upstream_ok=true and rate_limit_ok=true

alex: thanks all. Tag #incidents if error rate >2% sustained for 5m. Otherwise proceed with the plan. :thumbsup:

maria: noted, will watch dashboards and alert on anomalies.

cheng: PR review done, left one small comment. back to you @alex.

alex: addressed comment and merged PR #4831. Watching + keeping rollback plan ready.

maria: perf check after merge: 99p latency eu-west-1 = 164ms (baseline 158ms) — acceptable. Will continue monitoring.

olivia: auth rotation started on schedule, no issues so far. I'll update if anything changes.
